resource.name: SpecificationLibrary
resource.title: Specification Library
resource.description: A Library that is the package manifest for the Electronic Reporting and Surveillance Distribution (eRSD) 3rd Edition. It defines the components and dependencies that make up an eRSD specification version including reporting parameters, a Reportable Trigger Codes (RCTC) Library of the trigger code value sets, and the trigger code value sets themselves.

text.div:
Id: us-ecr-specification
Url: US eCR Specification
Version: 3.0.3
Title: US eCR Specification
Type:

system: http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/plan-definition-type

code: workflow-definition

display: Workflow Definition

Date: 2025-08-21 12:32:29-0500
Publisher: Association of Public Health Laboratories (APHL)
Description:

An eRSD PlanDefinition which includes the queries necessary for producing both CDA eICR R1.1 and CDA eICR R3.1 reports.
Jurisdiction: US
Effective Period: 2025-12-01..
Related Artifacts:

Dependencies

  • http://ersd.aimsplatform.org/fhir/Library/rctc
Actions:
Start the reporting workflow in response to an encounter-start event
When: Named Event: encounter-start
Check suspected disorders for immediate reportability and setup jobs for future reportability checks.
Then:
Check Trigger Codes based on Suspected Reportable and Lab Order Test Names Value set.
If: Applicability: (%suspectedDisorderEncounterDiagnosis.exists() or %suspectedDisorderConditions.exists() or %suspectedDisorderLabOrders.exists() or %suspectedDiagnosticOrders.exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%inProgressEncounterContinueCheck.where(((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration >= now()) or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours >= now())).select(true))
:
If: Applicability: (%terminatedencounter.where(((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration < now()) or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours < now())).select(true))
:
If: Applicability: (%lateCompletedEncounter.exists(status = 'finished'))
Check Reportability and setup jobs for future reportability checks.
Then:
Check Trigger Codes based on RCTC Value sets.
If: Applicability: ((%encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration >= now()) and (%conditions.exists() or %encounterDiagnoses.exists() or %medicationRequests.exists() or %medicationAdministrations.exists() or %medicationStatements.exists() or %diagnosticOrders.exists() or %diagnosticResultValues.exists() or %diagnosticResults.exists() or %encounters.exists() or %labOrders.exists() or %labTests.exists() or %labResults.exists() or %labResultValues.exists()))
:
If: Applicability: (%lastReportSubmissionDate < now() - 72 hours)
:
If: Applicability: (%inprogressencounter.where((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration >= now() or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours >= now())).exists() and %inprogressencounter.where(class.code='IMP' or class.code='EMER' or class.code='OBSENC').exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%ambinprogressencounter.where((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %ambulatoryReportingDuration >= now() or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours >= now())).exists() and %ambinprogressencounter.where(class.code='AMB' or class.code='VR' or class.code='HH').exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%termencounter.where(((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %normalReportingDuration < now()) or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours < now())).exists() and %termencounter.where(class.code='IMP' or class.code='EMER' or class.code='OBSENC').exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%termambencounter.where(((status = 'in-progress' or status = 'arrived') and %encounterStartDate + 1 day * %ambulatoryReportingDuration < now()) or (status = 'finished' and %encounterEndDate + 72 hours < now())).exists() and %termambencounter.where(class.code='AMB' or class.code='VR' or class.code='HH').exists())
:
If: Applicability: (%completedEncounter.exists(status = 'finished'))
Create eICR
Validate eICR
Route and send eICR
Start the reporting workflow in response to an encounter-modified event
When: Named Event: encounter-modified
Check Trigger Codes based on RCTC Value sets.
If: Applicability: (%modifiedConditions.exists() or %modifiedEncounterDiagnoses.exists() or %modifiedLabOrders.exists() or %modifiedLabTests.exists() or %modifiedLabResults.exists() or %modifiedLabResultValues.exists() or %modifiedDiagnosticResults.exists() or %modifiedDiagnosticResultValues.exists())

resource.name: Diagnosis_ProblemTriggersforPublicHealthReporting
resource.title: Diagnosis_Problem Triggers for Public Health Reporting
resource.description: Purpose: Clinical Focus - This set of values contains diagnoses or problems that represent that the patient may have a potentially reportable condition. For example, these may be diagnoses recorded in an EHR problem list and diagnosis codes used for billing for the encounter. Purpose: Data Element Scope - Diagnoses or problems documented in a clinical record. Purpose: Inclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Purpose: Exclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Note - Includes codes from selected value sets used in the Reportable Condition Knowledge Management System (RCKMS) reporting logic. RCKMS value sets in VSAC are for informational use only. When implementing trigger codes for electronic case reporting, use the Reportable Condition Trigger Codes (RCTC) file.

resource.title: Organism_Substance Release Triggers for Public Health Reporting
resource.description: Purpose: Clinical Focus - This set of values contains organism and substance names received in a laboratory results report, that may represent that the patient has a potentially reportable condition. These pertain to resulted laboratory reports, where the test method is a non-specific test (e.g., general cultures not specific to a condition) and the result value, coded in SNOMED, includes the organism or substance name. Purpose: Data Element Scope - Nominal laboratory result values documented in a clinical record. Purpose: Inclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Purpose: Exclusion Criteria - See individual value sets. Note - Includes codes from selected value sets used in the Reportable Condition Knowledge Management System (RCKMS) reporting logic. RCKMS value sets in VSAC are for informational use only. When implementing trigger codes for electronic case reporting, use the Reportable Condition Trigger Codes (RCTC) file.
